{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
data_clean = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Stratify by severity and compute response rate in each arm within each severity level
response_by_arm_severity = data_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()
print("Response rate by arm and severity:")
print(response_by_arm_severity)

# Compute the difference in response rate within each severity stratum
# We are interested in whether treatment improves response *within each severity group*
diff_by_severity = response_by_arm_severity.pivot(index='severity', columns='arm', values='responded')
diff_by_severity['diff'] = diff_by_severity['treatment'] - diff_by_severity['control']
print("\nDifference in response rate (treatment - control) by severity:")
print(diff_by_severity[['diff']])"}
